title: Past Lives
favouriteScene: The two-minute silence waiting for the Uber at night on a New York sidewalk before the taxi pulls away.
favouritePerformance: Greta Lee as Nora & Teo Yoo as Hae Sung
personalReflections: Devastating in its quiet maturity. A film that respects the present without trivializing the ghost of who we might have been in another life.
